title: About AMP India Foundation
summary: AMP India Foundation is a registered non-profit organisation delivering structured social services for underprivileged communities across India. It is managed through professional volunteer resources.
mission: AMP India Foundation is dedicated to promoting inclusive social progression by bridging structural development gaps for the under-served and needy all over India, entirely managed through professional volunteer resources.
vision: A unified central vision of trusted professional philanthropy that uplifts communities through education, employment, skill development, medical relief, and mentorship—without bias of caste, community, creed, or religion.

values.title: Trusted Professional Philanthropy
